title: Endocrine Unity and Diversity: A Cross-Tissue Single-Cell Regulatory Atlas

contributions.purpose: 构建跨组织人内分泌细胞单细胞调控图谱
contributions.mechanism: 整合 17 个人 scRNA-seq 数据集(CZ CELLxGENE,64→55→保留≥1% 内分泌细胞的 17),用 scVI 去批次(scib-metrics 基准择优)
contributions.evaluation: 资源型图谱;整合方法用 scib-metrics 综合评分排名(scVI vs ComBat),定性为主无单一指标
contributions.domain: 计算生物学 / 内分泌单细胞
contributions.source_quote: We built a cross-tissue single-cell atlas by integrating 17 human scRNA-seq datasets from diverse organs. Using scVI for robust harmonization

contributions.purpose: 揭示保守的泛内分泌分泌通路程序
contributions.mechanism: CoVarNet(K=12)+ cNMF(k=30)分解转录程序,识别 ER/UPR 与分泌颗粒生成模块
contributions.evaluation: 定性发现:保守 UPR/分泌颗粒模块构成共享'分泌骨架',叠加组织特异模块
contributions.source_quote: we identify conserved endoplasmic reticulum stress/unfolded-protein-response (UPR) and secretory-granule-biogenesis modules that form a shared backbone for hormone production and trafficking

contributions.purpose: 刻画内分泌身份的组合式 TF 编码
contributions.mechanism: 以 SCENIC 做 TF 中心网络推断,分析泛内分泌与组织限定调控因子的组合
contributions.evaluation: 定性:NEUROG3 等广谱因子 + PDX1/CDX2 等组织限定因子的组合码,镜像发育起源
contributions.source_quote: regulatory networks mirror developmental origins and are shaped by combinatorial codes of broadly acting pan-endocrine regulators together with tissue-restricted factors

notes: 有真实署名作者(WashU),agent 署名 Claude Code/ChatGPT/Gemini。无自声明编号列表,贡献由 abstract+intro+conclusion 归纳(资源+2 发现)。诚实 trade-off/局限:数据集组织覆盖不均、稀有内分泌类型代表不足;UPR 模块可能是组织解离伪迹,无时序数据难归因;网络推断为相关性(nominating not proving causality);cNMF rank/scVI 嵌入选择影响模块边界,频率仅可定性解读。checklist B/D/D/D(文本≥95% 由 LLM 草拟、分析大部分 Claude Code);AI 自认局限:需显式分步引导、生物洞见偏浅、擅长成熟框架而弱于发明新方法、'account memory'效应,'agent AI is a useful accelerator, not an autonomous scientist'。无数据造假红旗,较干净,accept。
